verdict.rationale: Apple provides official SDKs/frameworks (MLX, Metal 4 with GPU Neural Accelerators, Core ML tooling) explicitly targeting Apple silicon like the M4 Max, letting AI-native developers build ML/GPU-accelerated applications. However, this is generic ML tooling rather than agentic-specific SDKs, and there is no independent/hands-on corroboration of building against these SDKs on M4 Max specifically. Missing for 10: agent-specific SDK evidence, independent developer corroboration, and confirmation of stability/perf claims by third parties.
